metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Sure, why not?’ and threw aim out the window
metadata.description:
Didn’t even mean to click, but hey, it worked.
Enemy probably uninstalling while I’m still blinking.
Click if your aim’s a dumpster fire but the game still loves you.

Tap if your aim ever ghosted but you still got the kill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
